pairing_unit: the published ESB clip (1,500 of them). The bootstrap CLUSTER is the call (10 of them). Recovered from a clip id by splitting on '@' and then on the first '-', the same convention data.variant_ids.published_sample_key and reproduction.esb_reference.published_segment_key already fix.
why_not_a_d1_evidence_supplement: TWO structural refusals, not an omission. (1) contracts.gate.FrozenCoreGate allows at most ONE supplement per gate, media or evidence, and this cell's dataset fragment must carry the d1_media_supplement that brings the @ts2 clips into D1's closure at all. (2) gate_evidence_identity requires an evidence supplement's ids_sha256 to equal the carrier's own default evidence layer's sample universe, and earnings22-original declares no evidence layer (data.carriers.EARNINGS22_ORIGINAL.evidence is None); a 1,500-clip id set could not equal a 125-call one in any case. The brief's evidence records therefore carry carrier_bound=False and the composed config pins the metadata table's bytes directly. This file is the pairing artifact and makes no identity claim.
